metadata.reason: Iowa SOS publishes 99 county-linked 2020 General precinct-result workbooks and a certified canvass, but this retained diagnostic has no immutable November 3, 2020 statewide or complete county GIS boundary artifact and no retained workbook bodies from which President identities, zero-vote rows, and non-geographic units can be independently counted. The SOS statewide precinct archive is expressly dated April 17, 2014, while SOS states that post-2020-census city and county precinct boundaries became effective January 15, 2022; neither is used for 2020 geometry. No result identity, geometry, crosswalk, or vote assignment is approved.
